keywords: executive summary, answer, key messages, synthesis
answers_question: What is the answer and why should I believe it?
required_elements: Governing answer in bold; 3-5 supporting arguments each with its key number; evidence dashes
avoid_when: the deck has no single answer yet: fix the storyline first

keywords: structured text, bold lead-in, findings, dense page
answers_question: What are the points and how do they group?
required_elements: Action title; bold lead-in per point; <=5 blocks; source if claims are factual
avoid_when: a chart would prove the point faster

keywords: chart, single chart, evidence, trend, comparison
answers_question: Does the data support the title's claim?
required_elements: Action title naming the datum; one chart; accent on the datum; source line
avoid_when: two ideas compete: split the slide

keywords: multiple charts, dashboard, panels, small multiples
answers_question: How do several related measures move together?
required_elements: One shared claim; aligned axes; each panel labelled; one source block

keywords: waterfall, bridge, walk, variance, ebitda bridge
answers_question: How did we get from A to B?
required_elements: Steps that sum exactly; largest step in accent; totals labelled
avoid_when: more than ~8 steps or mixed periods

keywords: table, data table, comparison table, matrix
answers_question: How do these items compare across the same attributes?
required_elements: Right-aligned numerics; one precision per column; highlighted row for the subject; source
avoid_when: fewer than 3 rows: use a sentence or a chart

keywords: trading comps, comparable companies, multiples, peers
answers_question: What do peers trade at and where does the subject sit?
required_elements: EV and multiples columns; median row; subject row tinted; as-of date; definitions

keywords: football field, valuation summary, valuation ranges, offer
answers_question: What is it worth and where does the offer fall?
required_elements: One bar per method with assumptions in the label; offer line; units; source

keywords: sensitivity, heat map table, wacc, terminal growth
answers_question: How much does the answer move with the key assumptions?
required_elements: Two variables; base case outlined; two-step fill against a threshold
avoid_when: the model is not built yet

keywords: financial summary, projections, p&l, management case
answers_question: What does the business earn now and in the plan?
required_elements: Periods as columns; case named; units line; margins as %

keywords: framework, 2x2, matrix, driver tree, value chain
required_elements: Framework chosen by question (frameworks.md); labelled key element
avoid_when: decorative diagrams whose shape carries no meaning

keywords: observations, findings table, recommendations table, assessment
answers_question: What did we observe and what do we recommend for each area?
required_elements: Columns: area, observation, implication/recommendation; bold lead-ins
avoid_when: a single finding: use an action title and a chart

answers_question: What does the reader need to know first?
avoid_when: more than one page of background

keywords: options, alternatives, criteria, harvey balls, trade-offs
answers_question: Which option is best, on what criteria?
required_elements: Exclusive options; stated criteria; recommended row highlighted

keywords: roadmap, timeline, phases, gantt, plan, waves
answers_question: When does what happen, and who owns it?
avoid_when: more than ~6 workstreams on one page

answers_question: What must the reader decide or do?
required_elements: Decision, owner, date, value at stake

answers_question: Where are we in the argument?
required_elements: Agenda with current section highlighted (consulting) or title-only (banking)
